# CREST Olympiads

> > CREST Olympiads offers international academic competitions in Mathematics (CMO), Science (CSO), and English (CEO) for students from KG to Class 10.

CREST Olympiads is a platform for students to participate in online Olympiad examinations across multiple subjects, celebrating academic excellence through international, country, and state-level rankings. The site showcases achievers and provides registration information for the 2025-26 academic year.

## Key Topics

- CREST Mathematics Olympiad (CMO)
- CREST Science Olympiad (CSO)
- CREST English Olympiad (CEO)
- CREST Reasoning Olympiad (CRO)
- International Rank
- State Rank
- Country Rank
- Online Olympiad Registration
- Academic Competition
- Student Achievement
- Olympiad Exam Preparation
- 2025-26 Registration
- KG to Class 10
- Academic Excellence
- Student Success Stories

## Registration & Overview

- [Olympiad Exams 2025-26: Register for Online Olympiad Exams](https://www.crestolympiads.com): Homepage for CREST Olympiads registration for Maths, Science & English exams

## Achievers Gallery

- [CREST Achievers - View the achievers of CREST Olympiads](https://www.crestolympiads.com/achievers): Gallery of CREST Olympiad award winners and top performers
- [Video Testimonials - CREST Olympiads](https://www.crestolympiads.com/achievers-videos): Student video testimonials showcasing CREST Olympiad success stories
